reason_not_complete: No fresh artifact proves human presence detection in the lab.
No fresh artifact proves voice TTS acknowledgement to Dave or another human.
No fresh artifact proves human-name memory update.
No fresh artifact proves object inventory or unknown-object inquiry.
No fresh artifact proves all-camera cycling including the arm camera.

do_not_mark_satisfied_until: MIM detects a human entering or present in the lab and records sensor evidence.
MIM initiates a TTS interaction with that human.
MIM records the interaction in memory with the human name when known.
MIM records Dave as primary operator when Dave is identified.
MIM inventories visible lab objects and asks about unknown objects.
MIM cycles every available camera, including the arm camera, and records per-camera evidence.
instruction_to_mim.tod_role: monitor and evaluate only; convert stalls or failures into learning objectives; do not implement the hardware/camera/TTS work for MIM.

learning_objective_created.title: Resume the operator's active objective after completing an unrelated growth or idle check
learning_objective_created.lesson: A healthy completed growth objective is not success for the operator's active lab-awareness objective. MIM must return to the active operator objective and produce evidence for each required outcome.
